product.audience: Fragrance collectors choosing an extrait and discovery composition
product.decision: Understand the formula evolution, concentration and scent profile
product.conversion: Compose a three-note discovery vial and request a sample dossier

signature.moment: A 3D glass vessel distils through raw molecules, liquid concentrate and sealed extrait as scroll separates the cap, atomiser, glass and coloured formula

systems.hero: A laboratory balance sheet frames a live glass vessel and floating ingredient field, not a campaign portrait
systems.navigation: Formula index with batch, concentration and sample coordinate
systems.contentDensity: Sensory spatial hero followed by precise perfumer formula, volatility and batch data
systems.geometry: Vessel silhouettes, droplet columns, molecule constellations, chromatography curves and lab labels
systems.motion: Scroll distils the bottle assembly; explicit note controls reorganise particles and atomiser causes one short controlled burst
systems.coreInteraction: Visitors isolate top, heart and base materials, inspect evaporation, choose three notes and receive a visible discovery formula

structuralDifferences: The bottle becomes a tall hand-held chamber with explicit raw, liquid and sealed controls
Particle field is reduced while note results move into a thumb-accessible blotter strip
The desktop formula organ becomes sequential top, heart and base columns
Sample composition and confirmation remain in-flow as a folding lab label

artDirection.typography: High-contrast system serif for scent language, scientific grotesk and mono formula notation
artDirection.material: Optical glass, smoky plum liquid, polished aluminium, acid chartreuse molecules and parchment labels
artDirection.imageLogic: Bottle, liquid, atomiser and ingredient field are code-native WebGL; chromatography and blotters are SVG/CSS
artDirection.microcopy: Volatility, tincture, absolute, headspace, maceration, dosage, trail and batch language
artDirection.dataHonesty: Formula percentages, materials, batches and availability are fictional and clearly identified

adjacentTemplates.why: AUREL is a sticky image campaign and bag drawer; this is a spatial formula chamber and discovery laboratory.
VAPOR uses a three-state weather story and allocation flow; this distils physical vessel layers and composes a sample formula.
No campaign collection, gems or cart; ingredient volatility and dosage form the information system.
A fragrance organ and evaporation curve replace cosmetics merchandising and product routine patterns.
Both use 3D but glass distillation, particles and formula dosing differ from radial mechanical assembly and chronometry.

avoid: Copied bottle silhouette or fashion-house branding
